## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -29.43%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: -0.31% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION show mixed risk signals while SPY (1W: -0.02% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION vs TLT (1W: +0.17% | 1M: -1.53%) RECOVERY confirm no clean directional impulse.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -29.43%) BELOW TREND is easing headline volatility. Credit signaling mixed: HYG (1W: -0.31% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION show uneven credit flows; weak breadth (4/11) is the limiting factor.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -1.20%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: +0.17% | 1M: -1.53%) RECOVERY point to steady dollar/yields while Stocks vs Bonds (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +5.92%) CORRECTION shows equity leadership short-term but not broad enough.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Mixed leadership: XLK (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND and Materials (sector 1W: +0.86% | 1M: +10.34%) showing strength, while XLU (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -3.14%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -0.68%) BELOW TREND lag; style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mid-cycle: SPY (1W: -0.02% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION; EM/Emerging strength supportive with EEM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +1.14%) ABOVE TREND, but regional divergences persist.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation healthy: ARKK (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +11.92%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +2.57% | 1M: +1.94%) ABOVE TREND with Speculation Index rising; IWM (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +9.83%) CORRECTION signals small-cap momentum but with recent pullbacks.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity upside led by precious metals and base metals: SLV (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +33.09%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND; GLD (1W: +0.81% | 1M: +6.45%) ABOVE TREND reflecting safe-haven and inflation mix.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy soft: XLE (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -0.68%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -15.46%) BELOW TREND; BNO (1W: +0.11% | 1M: -3.92%) RECOVERY shows localized moves but overall weakness.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.07% | 1M: +5.36%) ABOVE TREND show durable tech strength. DIVERGENCE: SPY (1W: -0.02% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION, XLF (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +7.30%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: +0.17% | 1M: -1.53%) RECOVERY signal MAJOR divergence across core ETFs — supports the CAUTION label.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective exposure to tech and materials via XLK (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND and commodity proxies like CPER (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to utilities XLU (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -3.14%) BELOW TREND and energy XLE (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -0.68%) BELOW TREND while keeping bond allocations neutral.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND and Materials (sector 1W: +0.86% | 1M: +10.34%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -0.68%) BELOW TREND and Utilities XLU (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -3.14%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +33.09%) ABOVE TREND and Copper CPER (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -15.46%) BELOW TREND and broader oil proxies BNO (1W: +0.11% | 1M: -3.92%) RECOVERY until momentum confirms.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 27.86 (VXX 1W: -5.75% | 1M: -29.43%) — watch below ~20 for complacency. Credit spread ~0.73 (level 0.7297) — watch for widening as risk flag. XLK/XLF ratio 2.6368 (XLK 1W: +1.62% | 1M: +6.26%; XLF 1W: -0.27% | 1M: +7.30%) — watch for rotation if ratio reverts.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -29.43%) BELOW TREND and mixed credit signals support a limited-risk stance. Technology XLK (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +6.26%) and Materials (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +10.34%) showing strength while Energy XLE (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -0.68%) and Utilities XLU (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -3.14%) show weakness; monitor the SPY/XLF/TLT divergences closely.
